title: Tuna Salad with Light Mayonnaise Dressing

content.title: About
content.content: Tuna salad with light mayonnaise dressing (1606) is a ready‑to‑eat salad made from premium tuna mixed with a light mayo‑type dressing. It offers a delicate fish flavor, creamy texture, and moderate calories, making it a convenient option for a quick snack or meal addition.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Tuna is one of the richest natural sources of omega‑3 fatty acids, beneficial for heart and brain health.
Light mayonnaise dressing typically contains less fat and calories than regular mayo, using reduced‑fat oils and yogurt.
The salad is popular in school cafeterias and office lunchrooms because of its long shelf life when stored properly.
Canned tuna can be stored for up to 2‑3 years if the package remains intact.
In some countries the product is classified as a "quick‑serve" item, simplifying its labeling requirements.

items.title: Rich in omega‑3
items.content: Omega‑3 fatty acids help lower triglyceride levels and support cardiovascular health.

items.title: High protein content
items.content: Tuna provides about 20‑25 g of protein per 100 g, aiding muscle maintenance.

items.title: Low fat
items.content: The light mayo dressing reduces overall fat content, making the salad more diet‑friendly.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Tuna supplies vitamin B12, niacin, and riboflavin, important for energy metabolism.

items.title: Minerals
items.content: The product contains selenium, phosphorus, and potassium, supporting immunity and electrolyte balance.

items.title: Fish allergy
items.content: Individuals allergic to seafood may experience reactions to tuna.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Canned tuna often contains added salt; people with hypertension should monitor portion size.

items.title: Mercury risk
items.content: Tuna can contain trace amounts of mercury; moderate consumption is advised, especially for children and pregnant women.

items.title: Additive content
items.content: Some light mayo formulations may include artificial sweeteners or preservatives that not everyone tolerates.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: The salad is ready to eat straight from the package. It can be added to sandwiches, wraps, vegetable salads, or used as a filling for pies. For extra freshness, mix in chopped vegetables, herbs, or a squeeze of lemon juice.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place at temperatures up to 25 °C. Once opened, keep refrigerated at 2‑4 °C and consume within 3‑5 days. Discard if an off‑odor or discoloration develops.
